script: What happened to the airless basketball? Back in 2023, it went viral when the NBA used it in the dunk contest, and soon everyone wanted to get their hands on it. People even began making their own 3D printed ball because of how silent it was and the fact it dribbled like a normal basketball. There were even rumors that the NBA would be switching to this new ball by 2030, but the only problem was that it cost $2500! And this is where the hype began to die down. But it was also because of how the ball was made, as when someone shot with it for the first time, they would always airball. This is due to all the holes in it, affecting how it travels in the air, and even the best shooter Steph Curry airballed with it.
